_note: Document-style institutional pages. Each page renders: intro, optional highlights, sections, people (members/officers), timeline and documents. Empty lists render an honest empty state pointing to the current official page.

pages.title: Governing Body
pages.intro: The Governing Body is the apex statutory body of the college. It oversees institutional policy, finance, appointments and development, as required by AICTE and the affiliating university.

sections.title: Role
items: Approve institutional policies and strategic plans
Ensure compliance with AICTE, UGC and university norms

pages.title: Academic Council
pages.intro: The Academic Council is responsible for academic standards: curricula, regulations, examinations and evaluation.

sections.title: Responsibilities
items: Approve curricula and syllabi recommended by the Boards of Studies

pages.title: Board of Studies
pages.intro: Each department has a Board of Studies that reviews and proposes curriculum, courses and teaching practice for its programs.

pages.title: Internal Quality Assurance Cell
pages.intro: The IQAC plans, guides and monitors quality assurance and enhancement across the college's academic and administrative activities.

sections.title: About IQAC
items: Develop quality benchmarks for academic and administrative activities
Prepare the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR)

pages.title: NAAC
pages.intro: The National Assessment and Accreditation Council assesses and accredits higher education institutions on quality parameters. The college is NAAC certified.

pages.title: AICTE
pages.intro: The college's engineering programs are approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi.

pages.title: UGC
pages.intro: Disclosures and compliance with University Grants Commission mandates.

pages.title: NIRF
pages.intro: The National Institutional Ranking Framework ranks institutions on teaching, research, graduation outcomes, outreach and perception. This page publishes the data the college submits.

pages.title: ISO Certification
pages.intro: The college follows an ISO-compliant quality management system for its academic and administrative processes.

sections.title: Quality objectives
items: Deliver the curriculum effectively and on schedule

sections.title: Scope
items: Scope of certification will be published from the official certificate.

pages.title: Institution's Innovation Council
pages.intro: The IIC, established under the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell, promotes innovation, IPR awareness and entrepreneurship among students and faculty.

pages.title: Right to Information
pages.intro: Information about the college can be requested under the Right to Information Act, 2005.

sections.title: How to apply
items: Write an application to the Public Information Officer stating the information required
Include your name, address and contact details
Submit in person or by post to the college address
Information will be provided within the time limit set by the Act

pages.title: Reports
pages.intro: Annual reports, AQARs, audit statements and other institutional reports.

pages.title: Downloads
pages.intro: Forms, notices and frequently requested documents.
